children.text: In this interview the podcast Pár praslenov talks with the archaeologists Mgr. Erika Makarová, PhD., and Mgr. Peter Bisták about Oblík, a unique archaeological site in eastern Slovakia. We shall present the position and character of the site, its significance in the context of the prehistoric occupation of the region and the results of the archaeological excavations carried out so far. We shall talk about the finds that have been discovered, about their dating and about what they reveal to us concerning the life of the ancient communities that inhabited this area.

We shall also learn about the wider context of the occupation of eastern Slovakia in prehistory, about the communication routes, the contacts between individual cultures and the strategic significance of the site in the landscape.
Our Hradiská civic association took an active part in this excavation, together with colleagues from the Archeo Moravia association.
